example.zh: 春天来了，大地一片绿色，到处充满生机。
example.en: Spring has arrived; the land is all green and full of life everywhere.

quiz.zh: 一场大雪过后，大地白茫茫一片，美极了。
quiz.en: After a heavy snowfall, the land was a vast expanse of white. It was beautiful.

example.zh: 他看书很杂，历史、科学、小说什么都看。
example.en: He reads very widely: history, science, novels, anything at all.

quiz.zh: 这家小店卖的东西很杂，从文具到零食应有尽有。
quiz.en: This little shop sells all sorts of things, from stationery to snacks.

捉.gloss: to catch, to capture (e.g. an animal)

example.zh: 小时候，我们夏天常常在田里捉青蛙。
example.en: When we were kids, we often caught frogs in the fields in summer.

quiz.zh: 孩子们拿着小网兜在花丛中捉蝴蝶，玩得可开心了。
quiz.en: The children were catching butterflies among the flowers with little nets, having a great time.

example.zh: 公司在经营过程中必须遵守国家的相关法规。
example.en: A company must comply with the relevant national laws and regulations in its operations.

quiz.zh: 新的交通法规下个月起实施，酒后驾车将受到更严厉的处罚。
quiz.en: The new traffic regulations take effect next month, and drink-driving will be punished more severely.

example.zh: 下了一夜大雨，路边的沟里全是水。
example.en: After a whole night of heavy rain, the ditches by the road were full of water.

quiz.zh: 他骑车时没看清路，连人带车掉进了路旁的沟里。
quiz.en: Not watching the road while cycling, he fell into the roadside ditch, bike and all.

example.zh: 登山时千万不要离开同伴，一个人走很容易迷路。
example.en: Never leave your companions when mountain climbing; it's easy to get lost on your own.

quiz.zh: 小鸟受伤后飞不动了，它的同伴一直在旁边守着它。
quiz.en: The little bird was injured and couldn't fly, and its companion stayed by its side the whole time.

不已.gloss: endlessly, incessantly (after a verb of feeling)

example.zh: 听到儿子考上大学的消息，妈妈激动不已。
example.en: Hearing that her son had got into university, the mother was overcome with excitement.

quiz.zh: 看到地震后的废墟，在场的人都感叹不已。
quiz.en: Seeing the ruins after the earthquake, everyone present sighed again and again.

example.zh: 这种饮料不含任何添加剂，用的都是天然原料。
example.en: This drink contains no additives; it uses only natural ingredients.

quiz.zh: 这里有一个天然形成的湖泊，四周群山环绕，风景非常美。
quiz.en: There is a naturally formed lake here, surrounded by mountains, with beautiful scenery.

违规.gloss: to break the rules, to violate regulations

example.zh: 他因为在高速公路上违规停车被罚了两百元。
example.en: He was fined 200 yuan for illegally stopping on the motorway.

quiz.zh: 比赛中这名球员多次违规，最后被裁判罚下场了。
quiz.en: This player broke the rules several times during the match and was finally sent off by the referee.

example.zh: 付款之前，请再确认一下转账金额是否正确。
example.en: Before paying, please double-check that the transfer amount is correct.

quiz.zh: 这份合同的金额高达五千万元，是公司今年最大的一笔生意。
quiz.en: This contract is worth as much as 50 million yuan, the company's biggest deal this year.

example.zh: 工地上的工人每天早上七点就开始干活了。
example.en: The workers on the construction site start work at seven every morning.

quiz.zh: 他大学毕业后在建筑公司上班，经常要去工地检查进度。
quiz.en: After graduating he joined a construction company and often has to go to building sites to check progress.

example.zh: 地震发生后，全国各地的人们纷纷为灾区捐款。
example.en: After the earthquake, people all over the country donated money to the disaster area.

quiz.zh: 这笔捐款将全部用于帮助山区的孩子上学。
quiz.en: All of this donation will be used to help children in the mountains go to school.

主演.gloss: to star in; leading actor or actress

example.zh: 这部电影由一位年轻演员主演，上映后好评不断。
example.en: This film stars a young actor and has received rave reviews since its release.

quiz.zh: 她是这部电视剧的主演，最近走到哪儿都有人认出她。
quiz.en: She's the lead in this TV series, and lately people recognize her wherever she goes.

example.zh: 爷爷留着长长的白胡子，看起来很有精神。
example.en: Grandpa has a long white beard and looks full of energy.

quiz.zh: 他好几天没刮胡子了，看上去老了十岁。
quiz.en: He hasn't shaved for several days and looks ten years older.

example.zh: 当时我没觉得什么，过后想想才觉得有点后怕。
example.en: I didn't think much of it at the time; only afterwards did I realize how scary it was.

quiz.zh: 暴风雨过后，天边出现了一道美丽的彩虹。
quiz.en: After the storm, a beautiful rainbow appeared in the sky.

example.zh: 用这根数据线，手机里的照片很快就能传输到电脑上。
example.en: With this cable, the photos on your phone can be transferred to the computer quickly.

quiz.zh: 新一代网络的数据传输速度比以前快了好几倍。
quiz.en: Data transmission on the new generation of networks is several times faster than before.

同行.gloss: to be in the same line of work; person in the same profession

example.zh: 我们俩是同行，都在做软件开发。
example.en: We're in the same line of work; we both do software development.

quiz.zh: 他的设计水平很高，连不少同行都很佩服他。
quiz.en: His design skills are excellent; even many people in his own profession admire him.

急救.gloss: first aid, emergency treatment; to give emergency treatment

example.zh: 公司组织员工学习急救知识，以防万一。
example.en: The company organized first-aid training for its staff, just in case.

quiz.zh: 老人突然晕倒在地，路过的医生马上对他进行了急救。
quiz.en: The old man suddenly fainted, and a passing doctor immediately gave him emergency treatment.

恰恰.gloss: exactly, precisely (often contrary to what one expects)

example.zh: 你以为他不在乎，其实恰恰相反，他比谁都在意。
example.en: You think he doesn't care, but it's exactly the opposite; he cares more than anyone.

quiz.zh: 很多人觉得休息浪费时间，可适当休息恰恰能提高效率。
quiz.en: Many people think rest wastes time, but proper rest is precisely what improves efficiency.

example.zh: 山脚下有一个小村庄，住着几十户人家。
example.en: At the foot of the mountain there is a small village of a few dozen families.

quiz.zh: 洪水过后，这个村庄的房屋几乎全被冲毁了。
quiz.en: After the flood, almost every house in this village had been washed away.

example.zh: 他真诚的态度打动了面试官，最后被录取了。
example.en: His sincerity moved the interviewer, and he was hired in the end.

quiz.zh: 这首歌的歌词很简单，却打动了无数听众的心。
quiz.en: The lyrics of this song are simple, yet they have touched the hearts of countless listeners.

example.zh: 为了一点小事，他们俩在饭桌上争吵起来。
example.en: The two of them started quarrelling at the dinner table over a trivial matter.

quiz.zh: 隔壁夫妻经常大声争吵，邻居们都受不了了。
quiz.en: The couple next door often argue loudly, and the neighbours can't stand it any more.

example.zh: 公司建立了新的奖励机制，员工的积极性明显提高了。
example.en: The company set up a new reward system, and staff motivation has clearly improved.

quiz.zh: 科学家们至今还没有完全弄清这种疾病的发病机制。
quiz.en: Scientists still haven't fully worked out the mechanism by which this disease develops.

example.zh: 他经常工作到深夜，身体越来越差。
example.en: He often works late into the night, and his health keeps getting worse.

quiz.zh: 已经是深夜了，街上几乎看不到行人。
quiz.en: It was already late at night, and there was hardly anyone on the streets.

透过.gloss: through (to see or pass through something)

example.zh: 阳光透过窗户照进房间，暖洋洋的。
example.en: Sunlight shone into the room through the window, nice and warm.

quiz.zh: 透过现象看本质，才能找到问题的真正原因。
quiz.en: Only by looking through the surface to the essence can you find the real cause of a problem.

一带.gloss: area, region, (the area) around a place

example.zh: 这一带以前是农田，现在已经盖满了高楼。
example.en: This area used to be farmland; now it's covered with high-rise buildings.

quiz.zh: 长江中下游一带夏天又热又潮湿。
quiz.en: The area along the middle and lower reaches of the Yangtze is hot and humid in summer.

example.zh: 他摔倒时面部受了点伤，好在不严重。
example.en: He hurt his face a bit when he fell, but fortunately it wasn't serious.

quiz.zh: 这款手机可以通过面部识别解锁，非常方便。
quiz.en: This phone can be unlocked with facial recognition, which is very convenient.

example.zh: 他大学学的是医药专业，毕业后进了一家药厂。
example.en: He studied medicine and pharmacy at university and joined a drug factory after graduating.

quiz.zh: 随着人口老龄化，医药行业的市场需求越来越大。
quiz.en: As the population ages, market demand in the pharmaceutical industry keeps growing.

example.zh: 遇到突发情况时，一定要保持冷静。
example.en: When something unexpected happens, you must stay calm.

quiz.zh: 他昨晚突发心脏病，被紧急送进了医院。
quiz.en: He suddenly had a heart attack last night and was rushed to hospital.

听取.gloss: to listen to (opinions, reports), to hear

example.zh: 领导应该多听取群众的意见。
example.en: Leaders should listen more to the opinions of ordinary people.

quiz.zh: 在做最后决定之前，校长认真听取了老师和家长的建议。
quiz.en: Before making the final decision, the principal listened carefully to the suggestions of teachers and parents.

example.zh: 请你把箱子里的东西数一数，看看数目对不对。
example.en: Please count the things in the box and see if the number is right.

quiz.zh: 五十万对刚工作的年轻人来说，可不是一笔小数目。
quiz.en: Half a million is no small sum for a young person just starting work.

example.zh: 这位艺人经常参加公益活动，很受粉丝喜爱。
example.en: This entertainer often takes part in charity events and is much loved by fans.

quiz.zh: 街头艺人在广场上表演杂技，吸引了很多游客。
quiz.en: Street performers were doing acrobatics in the square, attracting many tourists.

example.zh: 这家小饭馆的红烧肉特别出名，每天都排长队。
example.en: This little restaurant is famous for its braised pork; there's a long queue every day.

quiz.zh: 这个小镇因为出产好茶而出名。
quiz.en: This small town is well known for producing fine tea.

example.zh: 老人拄着一根木棍，慢慢地往山上走。
example.en: Leaning on a wooden stick, the old man slowly walked up the mountain.

quiz.zh: 他从地上捡起一根棍，把挡在路中间的树枝拨开了。
quiz.en: He picked up a stick from the ground and pushed aside the branches blocking the path.

example.zh: 这孩子很听话，从来不让父母操心。
example.en: This child is very well-behaved and never gives his parents anything to worry about.

quiz.zh: 我的电脑最近一点儿也不听话，动不动就死机。
quiz.en: My computer won't do what it's told lately; it freezes at the drop of a hat.

example.zh: 他的言语中透露出对未来的担忧。
example.en: His words revealed his worries about the future.

quiz.zh: 有时候一个拥抱比任何言语都更能安慰人。
quiz.en: Sometimes a hug comforts people more than any words can.

example.zh: 请把合同用传真发过来，我们确认后马上签字。
example.en: Please fax the contract over; we'll sign as soon as we've checked it.

quiz.zh: 现在大家都用电子邮件，办公室里的传真机已经很少用了。
quiz.en: Everyone uses email now, so the office fax machine is hardly used any more.

example.zh: 这次会议极为重要，所有部门经理都必须参加。
example.en: This meeting is extremely important; all department managers must attend.

quiz.zh: 这种鸟数量极为稀少，已经被列为保护动物。
quiz.en: This bird is extremely rare and has been listed as a protected species.

example.zh: 过年时，家里总会准备很多糖果招待客人。
example.en: At New Year, the family always gets lots of sweets ready for guests.

quiz.zh: 牙医提醒孩子们少吃糖果，饭后要记得刷牙。
quiz.en: The dentist reminded the children to eat fewer sweets and to brush their teeth after meals.

example.zh: 这张优惠券可以在全国所有分店使用。
example.en: This coupon can be used at all branches nationwide.

quiz.zh: 凭这张入场券，您可以免费参观博物馆的所有展厅。
quiz.en: With this admission ticket, you can visit all the museum's halls for free.

example.zh: 这家超市专门卖有机蔬菜，价格比普通的贵一些。
example.en: This supermarket specializes in organic vegetables, which cost a bit more than ordinary ones.

quiz.zh: 这些水果种植时不用化肥和农药，是真正的有机食品。
quiz.en: These fruits are grown without chemical fertilizers or pesticides; they're genuinely organic food.

example.zh: 这个月他迟到的次数太多，被经理批评了。
example.en: He was late too many times this month and got told off by the manager.

quiz.zh: 随着年龄增长，奶奶去医院的次数越来越多。
quiz.en: As she gets older, Grandma goes to the hospital more and more often.

example.zh: 浴室的地很滑，洗澡时要小心。
example.en: The bathroom floor is slippery, so be careful when you shower.

quiz.zh: 这套房子有两个卧室和一个带浴缸的浴室。
quiz.en: This flat has two bedrooms and a bathroom with a bathtub.

example.zh: 运动员们已经站在起点上，准备出发。
example.en: The athletes are already standing at the starting line, ready to go.

quiz.zh: 毕业不是结束，而是人生新的起点。
quiz.en: Graduation isn't an end but a new starting point in life.

创建.gloss: to establish, to found, to create

example.zh: 这所大学创建于1898年，已有一百多年的历史。
example.en: This university was founded in 1898 and has more than a hundred years of history.

quiz.zh: 打开软件后，先点击右上角的按钮创建一个新账号。
quiz.en: After opening the app, first click the button in the top right to create a new account.

example.zh: 是继续读研还是马上工作？考虑了很久，他最后选择了后者。
example.en: Go on to grad school or start working right away? After thinking it over for a long time, he chose the latter.

quiz.zh: 中医和西医各有优点：前者注重调理，后者见效更快。
quiz.en: Chinese and Western medicine each have strengths: the former focuses on regulating the body, while the latter works faster.

剩余.gloss: remaining, surplus; to be left over

example.zh: 这个月的工资交完房租，剩余的钱已经不多了。
example.en: After paying this month's rent out of my salary, there isn't much money left.

quiz.zh: 工厂把剩余的产品低价卖给了附近的商店。
quiz.en: The factory sold its surplus products cheaply to nearby shops.

example.zh: 南方和北方的饮食习惯存在很大的差异。
example.en: There are big differences between the eating habits of the south and the north.

quiz.zh: 由于文化差异，两国人对同一个手势的理解完全不同。
quiz.en: Because of cultural differences, people in the two countries understand the same gesture completely differently.

example.zh: 他点燃了生日蛋糕上的蜡烛，大家一起唱起了生日歌。
example.en: He lit the candles on the birthday cake, and everyone sang 'Happy Birthday' together.

quiz.zh: 奥运会开幕式上，最后一名火炬手点燃了主火炬。
quiz.en: At the Olympic opening ceremony, the final torchbearer lit the main cauldron.

example.zh: 这个问题不能只从经济层面考虑，还要考虑社会影响。
example.en: This issue can't be considered only on the economic level; its social impact must be considered too.

quiz.zh: 改革需要在国家层面统一规划，地方才能更好地执行。
quiz.en: Reform needs unified planning at the national level so that local governments can carry it out better.

占有.gloss: to possess, to own; to occupy, to hold (a share or position)

example.zh: 这家公司在国内市场上占有很大的份额。
example.en: This company holds a large share of the domestic market.

quiz.zh: 他对女朋友的占有欲太强，连她和朋友吃饭都要管。
quiz.en: He's too possessive of his girlfriend; he even wants a say when she has dinner with friends.

example.zh: 这个城市有很多外来人口，大多是来打工的年轻人。
example.en: This city has many people from elsewhere, mostly young people who came for work.

quiz.zh: “咖啡”“沙发”这些词都是外来词，最早来自其他语言。
quiz.en: Words like 'coffee' and 'sofa' are loanwords that originally came from other languages.

example.zh: 我的论文是在导师的指导下完成的。
example.en: I completed my thesis under the guidance of my supervisor.

quiz.zh: 读研究生期间，选一位好导师非常重要。
quiz.en: When doing a graduate degree, choosing a good supervisor is very important.

example.zh: 这本小说的开头写得非常吸引人。
example.en: The beginning of this novel is really gripping.

quiz.zh: 万事开头难，坚持下去就会越来越顺利。
quiz.en: Every beginning is hard; keep at it and things will go more and more smoothly.

example.zh: 政府加大了对环境污染的处罚力度。
example.en: The government has stepped up penalties for environmental pollution.

quiz.zh: 按摩的力度要适中，太轻没效果，太重又会疼。
quiz.en: Massage pressure should be moderate: too light has no effect, too hard will hurt.

example.zh: 一直往前走，到第二个路口往左拐就到了。
example.en: Go straight ahead and turn left at the second intersection, and you're there.

quiz.zh: 出租车拐进一条小巷，在一家饭馆门口停了下来。
quiz.en: The taxi turned into a small lane and stopped in front of a restaurant.

备用.gloss: spare, backup; to keep in reserve

example.zh: 出门旅行最好带一块备用电池。
example.en: When you travel, it's best to bring a spare battery.

quiz.zh: 我在门口的花盆下面放了一把备用钥匙，以防忘带。
quiz.en: I keep a spare key under the flowerpot by the door in case I forget mine.

example.zh: 这款手机有三种型号，价格各不相同。
example.en: This phone comes in three models, each at a different price.

quiz.zh: 买打印机墨盒之前，要先查清楚打印机的型号。
quiz.en: Before buying ink cartridges, check your printer's model number first.

发放.gloss: to distribute, to issue, to hand out

example.zh: 每个月十号公司准时发放工资，从来没有拖欠过。
example.en: The company pays salaries on time on the 10th of every month and has never been late.

quiz.zh: 志愿者们在路口向市民免费发放口罩。
quiz.en: Volunteers were handing out free face masks to residents at the intersection.

example.zh: 这期培训班一共有三十名学员。
example.en: This training course has thirty trainees in total.

quiz.zh: 驾校的教练对每一位学员都非常耐心。
quiz.en: The driving school instructor is very patient with every learner.

example.zh: 他做事非常专注，一工作起来就忘了时间。
example.en: He's very focused; once he starts working he loses track of time.

quiz.zh: 开车时一定要专注，不能一边开车一边看手机。
quiz.en: You must stay focused when driving; you can't look at your phone while you drive.

example.zh: 这套系统存在安全漏洞，黑客很容易攻击进来。
example.en: This system has a security flaw, so hackers can easily break in.

quiz.zh: 他的说法前后矛盾，到处是漏洞，没人相信他。
quiz.en: His story contradicts itself and is full of holes; nobody believes him.

example.zh: 她很有才华，十几岁就出版了第一本小说。
example.en: She's very talented; she published her first novel as a teenager.

quiz.zh: 这次比赛给年轻设计师提供了一个展示才华的机会。
quiz.en: This competition gives young designers a chance to show off their talent.

example.zh: 一阵风吹过，平静的水面上泛起了波纹。
example.en: A gust of wind blew across, and ripples spread over the calm water.

quiz.zh: 一条大鱼突然跳出水面，把钓鱼的人吓了一跳。
quiz.en: A big fish suddenly leapt out of the water, startling the angler.

栏.gloss: railing, fence; column (in a newspaper or form)

example.zh: 请在表格的备注栏里写上您的联系方式。
example.en: Please write your contact details in the remarks column of the form.

quiz.zh: 报名表上的“特长”一栏，他想了半天也不知道该填什么。
quiz.en: He thought for ages about the "special skills" field on the application form but had no idea what to write.

查询.gloss: to look up, to check, to inquire

example.zh: 你可以在网上查询航班的实时信息。
example.en: You can check real-time flight information online.

quiz.zh: 考试成绩下周公布，考生可以登录官网查询。
quiz.en: Exam results will be released next week; candidates can log in to the official website to check them.

歌唱.gloss: to sing; to sing the praises of

example.zh: 这首歌歌唱了祖国的大好河山。
example.en: This song sings the praises of the country's beautiful landscapes.

quiz.zh: 鸟儿在枝头歌唱，春天真的来了。
quiz.en: Birds are singing on the branches; spring has really arrived.

求助.gloss: to ask for help, to seek help

example.zh: 遇到困难不要一个人扛着，要学会向别人求助。
example.en: Don't shoulder your difficulties alone; learn to ask others for help.

quiz.zh: 迷路的游客只好向当地警察求助。
quiz.en: The lost tourists had no choice but to ask the local police for help.

example.zh: 这个项目的进度比计划慢了两周。
example.en: This project is two weeks behind schedule.

quiz.zh: 老师根据学生的学习情况调整了教学进度。
quiz.en: The teacher adjusted the pace of teaching according to how the students were doing.

example.zh: 这条毛巾非常柔软，用起来很舒服。
example.en: This towel is very soft and nice to use.

quiz.zh: 这张床垫太柔软了，睡久了腰反而会疼。
quiz.en: This mattress is too soft; sleeping on it for long actually makes your back hurt.

运营.gloss: to operate, to run (a business or service)

example.zh: 这条地铁线路将于明年正式运营。
example.en: This subway line will officially open for service next year.

quiz.zh: 她负责公司社交媒体账号的日常运营。
quiz.en: She's in charge of the day-to-day running of the company's social media accounts.

example.zh: 他把要记的单词写在卡片上，随时拿出来复习。
example.en: He writes the words he needs to memorize on cards and takes them out to review whenever he can.

quiz.zh: 生日那天，我收到了同学们亲手做的卡片。
quiz.en: On my birthday I received handmade cards from my classmates.

心目.gloss: mind, view (in someone's eyes, in someone's mind)

example.zh: 在我心目中，父亲是世界上最了不起的人。
example.en: In my eyes, my father is the most amazing person in the world.

quiz.zh: 这家餐厅一直是大家心目中最好吃的火锅店。
quiz.en: This restaurant has always been everyone's idea of the best hotpot place.

example.zh: 冬天我们全家去东北滑雪，玩得特别开心。
example.en: In winter our whole family went skiing in the northeast and had a great time.

quiz.zh: 他第一次滑雪就摔断了腿，从此再也不敢上雪场了。
quiz.en: He broke his leg the first time he went skiing and has never dared to go to a ski resort since.

example.zh: 网上关于这家公司的负面新闻越来越多。
example.en: There's more and more negative news about this company online.

quiz.zh: 长期熬夜会给身体带来很多负面影响。
quiz.en: Staying up late over a long period has many negative effects on your health.

加以.gloss: to apply, to give (an action to something, before a two-syllable verb); in addition, moreover

example.zh: 对于学生提出的问题，老师应该及时加以解答。
example.en: Teachers should answer students' questions promptly.

quiz.zh: 这些建议很有价值，我们会认真加以研究。
quiz.en: These suggestions are very valuable; we will study them carefully.

再生.gloss: to regenerate, to grow again; to recycle (recycled)

example.zh: 这种笔记本是用再生纸做的，很环保。
example.en: This notebook is made of recycled paper, so it's eco-friendly.

quiz.zh: 壁虎的尾巴断了以后还能再生。
quiz.en: A gecko's tail can grow back after it breaks off.

example.zh: 1969年，美国宇航员第一次登上了月球。
example.en: In 1969, American astronauts landed on the Moon for the first time.

quiz.zh: 科学家正在研究将来能否在月球表面建立基地。
quiz.en: Scientists are studying whether a base could one day be built on the lunar surface.

example.zh: 公交车上，一个年轻人主动给一位老太太让了座。
example.en: On the bus, a young man offered his seat to an old lady.

quiz.zh: 楼下的老太太八十多岁了，每天还坚持去公园散步。
quiz.en: The old lady downstairs is over eighty but still goes for a walk in the park every day.

躲避.gloss: to hide from, to avoid, to dodge

example.zh: 为了躲避记者，那位明星从后门离开了酒店。
example.en: To avoid the reporters, the star left the hotel by the back door.

quiz.zh: 听到警报声后，居民们迅速躲避到附近的地下室里。
quiz.en: When they heard the siren, residents quickly took shelter in a nearby basement.

example.zh: 秋天的田野里到处是一派丰收的景象。
example.en: In autumn, the fields everywhere present a scene of rich harvest.

quiz.zh: 站在山上往下看，眼前的景象让所有人都惊呆了。
quiz.en: Looking down from the mountain, everyone was stunned by the sight before them.

后退.gloss: to step back, to retreat; to fall back

example.zh: 看到那条大狗冲过来，他吓得连连后退。
example.en: Seeing the big dog charge at him, he backed away in fright.

quiz.zh: 这次考试他的排名后退了十几名，父母很着急。
quiz.en: He dropped more than ten places in the rankings in this exam, and his parents are worried.

example.zh: 雷达可以发现远处飞行的物体。
example.en: Radar can detect objects flying far away.

quiz.zh: 物体从高处落下时，速度会越来越快。
quiz.en: When an object falls from a height, it falls faster and faster.

example.zh: 他在一家银行当普通职员，工作很稳定。
example.en: He works as an ordinary clerk at a bank; the job is very stable.

quiz.zh: 这家公司规模不大，只有二十几名职员。
quiz.en: This company isn't big; it has only twenty-odd staff.

旅途.gloss: journey, trip (the time on the road)

example.zh: 漫长的旅途中，他认识了很多有意思的人。
example.en: On the long journey, he met lots of interesting people.

quiz.zh: 祝你旅途愉快，到了记得给我打个电话。
quiz.en: Have a pleasant trip, and remember to give me a call when you arrive.

衡量.gloss: to measure, to judge; to weigh up

example.zh: 不能只用考试成绩来衡量一个学生的能力。
example.en: You can't judge a student's ability by exam results alone.

quiz.zh: 他仔细衡量了两份工作的利弊，最后决定留在老家。
quiz.en: He carefully weighed the pros and cons of the two jobs and finally decided to stay in his hometown.

师父.gloss: master (of a craft or martial art), teacher

example.zh: 他跟着师父学了三年手艺，终于能自己开店了。
example.en: He learned the craft from his master for three years and can finally open his own shop.

quiz.zh: 这位少林寺的师父每天天不亮就起来练功。
quiz.en: This master from the Shaolin Temple gets up before dawn every day to practise martial arts.

example.zh: 弟弟不小心把我心爱的杯子摔碎了。
example.en: My little brother accidentally smashed my favourite mug.

quiz.zh: 他终于把心爱的姑娘娶回了家。
quiz.en: He finally married the girl he loved.

example.zh: 这座建筑物已经有三百多年的历史了。
example.en: This building is more than three hundred years old.

quiz.zh: 地震中，这一带很多老旧的建筑物都倒塌了。
quiz.en: In the earthquake, many old buildings in this area collapsed.

example.zh: 这次旅程从北京出发，经过西安，最后到达成都。
example.en: This trip starts in Beijing, passes through Xi'an and ends in Chengdu.

quiz.zh: 这次自驾游的旅程全长两千多公里，一路经过五个省。
quiz.en: This road trip covers more than 2,000 kilometres and passes through five provinces.

example.zh: 这家咖啡店是本土品牌，在全国已有上千家分店。
example.en: This café is a homegrown brand with over a thousand branches nationwide.

quiz.zh: 很多外国快餐品牌进入中国后，都推出了本土化的菜品。
quiz.en: After entering China, many foreign fast-food brands launched localized dishes.

阻挡.gloss: to block, to stop, to obstruct

example.zh: 什么困难也阻挡不了他前进的脚步。
example.en: No difficulty can stop him from moving forward.

quiz.zh: 山上的树林能阻挡风沙，保护山下的农田。
quiz.en: The forest on the mountain can block wind and sand and protect the farmland below.

example.zh: 气象部门正在密切监测台风的路线。
example.en: The weather bureau is closely monitoring the typhoon's path.

quiz.zh: 这块手表可以随时监测心率和睡眠情况。
quiz.en: This watch can monitor your heart rate and sleep at any time.

叉.gloss: fork; cross (mark); to stick with a fork, to cross
叉.indonesian: garpu; tanda silang; menusuk dengan garpu, menyilangkan

example.zh: 吃西餐时，一般左手拿叉，右手拿刀。
example.en: When eating Western food, you usually hold the fork in your left hand and the knife in your right.

quiz.zh: 老师在他写错的地方画了一个叉。
quiz.en: The teacher drew a cross where he had made a mistake.

example.zh: 房间的墙壁刷成了淡蓝色，看起来很清爽。
example.en: The walls of the room were painted light blue and look fresh.

quiz.zh: 这栋楼的隔音不好，隔着墙壁都能听到邻居说话。
quiz.en: This building has poor soundproofing; you can hear the neighbours talking through the wall.

example.zh: 电灯的开关在门的右边，进门一伸手就能摸到。
example.en: The light switch is to the right of the door; you can reach it as soon as you walk in.

quiz.zh: 他在黑暗中摸了半天，才找到墙上的开关。
quiz.en: He groped around in the dark for ages before finding the switch on the wall.

example.zh: 这家工厂接到了一大笔海外订单，工人们天天加班。
example.en: The factory received a big overseas order, and the workers are doing overtime every day.

quiz.zh: 你在网上买的东西发货了吗？我帮你查一下订单。
quiz.en: Has the stuff you bought online been shipped? Let me check the order for you.

example.zh: 疫情期间，很多公司让员工在家远程办公。
example.en: During the pandemic, many companies had staff work remotely from home.

quiz.zh: 技术人员通过网络远程帮我修好了电脑。
quiz.en: The technician fixed my computer remotely over the internet.

example.zh: 当今社会，几乎每个人都离不开手机。
example.en: In today's society, almost everyone depends on their phone.

quiz.zh: 他是当今世界上最优秀的钢琴家之一。
quiz.en: He is one of the finest pianists in the world today.

恰好.gloss: as it happens, by chance; just right, exactly

example.zh: 我到车站的时候，公交车恰好开过来。
example.en: Just as I got to the stop, the bus happened to pull up.

quiz.zh: 你要找的那本书，我恰好有一本，明天带给你。
quiz.en: As it happens I have a copy of the book you're looking for; I'll bring it tomorrow.

改编.gloss: to adapt (e.g. a novel into a film); to rearrange

example.zh: 这部电视剧是根据一本畅销小说改编的。
example.en: This TV series is adapted from a best-selling novel.

quiz.zh: 他把一首老歌改编成了摇滚版，在网上很火。
quiz.en: He rearranged an old song as a rock version, and it's a big hit online.

example.zh: 带父母出国旅游一次，是我多年的心愿。
example.en: Taking my parents on a trip abroad has been my wish for years.

quiz.zh: 老人生前最大的心愿就是再见儿子一面。
quiz.en: The old man's greatest wish before he died was to see his son once more.

example.zh: 最近股市大跌，很多人亏了不少钱。
example.en: The stock market has crashed recently, and many people have lost a lot of money.

quiz.zh: 他每天早上第一件事就是打开手机看股市行情。
quiz.en: The first thing he does every morning is check the stock market on his phone.

example.zh: 对于一家新公司来说，第一年的发展至关重要。
example.en: For a new company, the first year of growth is crucial.

quiz.zh: 充足的睡眠对青少年的成长至关重要。
quiz.en: Getting enough sleep is vital for teenagers' growth.

识.gloss: to know, to recognize (e.g. to be able to read)

example.zh: 奶奶小时候没上过学，不识字。
example.en: Grandma never went to school as a child, so she can't read.

quiz.zh: 你真识货，这可是今年最好的茶叶。
quiz.en: You really know quality; this is the best tea of the year.

往后.gloss: from now on, in the future, later on

example.zh: 往后的日子还长，别为了这点小事难过。
example.en: You have a long life ahead of you; don't be upset over something so small.

quiz.zh: 这次就算了，往后再迟到，就要扣工资了。
quiz.en: I'll let it go this time, but from now on if you're late again, your pay will be docked.

example.zh: 春天的公园里处处都是鲜花。
example.en: In spring there are flowers everywhere in the park.

quiz.zh: 他刚来公司，处处小心，生怕出错。
quiz.en: He's new at the company and careful in everything, afraid of making mistakes.

不至于.gloss: not go so far as to, be unlikely to

example.zh: 他虽然脾气不好，但还不至于为这点小事发火。
example.en: He has a bad temper, but he wouldn't go so far as to blow up over something this small.

quiz.zh: 现在出发的话，应该不至于迟到。
quiz.en: If we leave now, we shouldn't end up being late.

同类.gloss: of the same kind, similar; the same kind

example.zh: 和同类产品相比，这款手机的价格更低。
example.en: Compared with similar products, this phone is cheaper.

quiz.zh: 有些动物会攻击自己的同类，争夺食物和地盘。
quiz.en: Some animals attack their own kind, competing for food and territory.

身心.indonesian: jiwa dan raga, fisik dan mental

example.zh: 经常运动有利于身心健康，还能让人心情变好。
example.en: Regular exercise is good for both body and mind, and it lifts your mood too.

quiz.zh: 连续加班一个月，他感到身心疲惫。
quiz.en: After a month of nonstop overtime, he felt physically and mentally exhausted.

使劲.gloss: to exert all one's strength, to try hard; hard

example.zh: 瓶盖太紧了，我使劲拧了半天也没打开。
example.en: The bottle cap was too tight; I twisted it as hard as I could but still couldn't open it.

quiz.zh: 听到这个好消息，他使劲地点了点头。
quiz.en: Hearing the good news, he nodded hard.

中奖.gloss: to win a prize (in a lottery or draw)

example.zh: 听说他买彩票中奖了，一下子得了五百万。
example.en: I heard he won the lottery and suddenly got five million.

quiz.zh: 恭喜您中奖了！请凭有效证件到服务台领奖。
quiz.en: Congratulations, you've won a prize! Please bring valid ID to the service desk to collect it.

example.zh: 她从小就喜欢诗歌，大学时还出版了一本诗集。
example.en: She has loved poetry since childhood and even published a collection at university.

quiz.zh: 这次诗歌朗诵比赛，有一百多名学生报名参加。
quiz.en: More than a hundred students signed up for this poetry recitation contest.

全程.gloss: the whole journey or course, the entire process

example.zh: 这次马拉松全程四十二公里，他跑了不到三个小时。
example.en: This marathon is 42 kilometres in total, and he ran it in under three hours.

quiz.zh: 比赛将进行全程直播，观众可以在网上观看。
quiz.en: The whole match will be broadcast live, and viewers can watch online.

认知.gloss: cognition, awareness; to recognize, to understand

example.zh: 小孩子对世界的认知是从模仿开始的。
example.en: Children's understanding of the world begins with imitation.

quiz.zh: 随着年龄增长，老人的认知能力会逐渐下降。
quiz.en: With age, elderly people's cognitive abilities gradually decline.

example.zh: 这家咖啡馆的氛围很好，很适合看书。
example.en: This café has a nice atmosphere and is great for reading.

quiz.zh: 春节快到了，街上到处挂着红灯笼，节日氛围越来越浓。
quiz.en: Spring Festival is coming; red lanterns hang everywhere in the streets and the festive atmosphere is growing.

example.zh: 他在海边向女朋友求婚，她感动得哭了。
example.en: He proposed to his girlfriend by the sea, and she was moved to tears.

quiz.zh: 交往三年后，他终于鼓起勇气求婚了，没想到被拒绝了。
quiz.en: After dating for three years he finally plucked up the courage to propose, but to his surprise he was turned down.

拆除.gloss: to demolish, to dismantle, to remove

example.zh: 这栋危楼下个月就要被拆除了。
example.en: This unsafe building will be demolished next month.

quiz.zh: 市政府决定拆除路边所有违规建造的广告牌。
quiz.en: The city government decided to remove all illegally built billboards along the roads.

example.zh: 这对双胞胎长得一模一样，连他们的妈妈有时都会认错。
example.en: These twins look exactly alike; even their mother sometimes mixes them up.

quiz.zh: 她今天穿的裙子和我的一模一样，真是太巧了。
quiz.en: The dress she's wearing today is identical to mine. What a coincidence!

example.zh: 以前北方冬天很多家庭都靠烧煤取暖。
example.en: In the past, many families in the north burned coal to keep warm in winter.

quiz.zh: 这座小城过去靠挖煤为生，现在转型发展旅游业了。
quiz.en: This small town used to live off coal mining; now it has switched to developing tourism.

example.zh: 银行转账要收取一定的手续费。
example.en: Banks charge a certain fee for transfers.

quiz.zh: 这家博物馆不收取任何费用，所有人都可以免费参观。
quiz.en: This museum charges no fees at all; everyone can visit for free.

强化.gloss: to strengthen, to intensify, to reinforce

example.zh: 考试前，老师给我们安排了两周的强化训练。
example.en: Before the exam, the teacher arranged two weeks of intensive training for us.

quiz.zh: 公司决定进一步强化员工的安全意识。
quiz.en: The company decided to further strengthen employees' safety awareness.

夺取.gloss: to seize, to capture; to win (a title)

example.zh: 中国队在决赛中击败对手，夺取了冠军。
example.en: The Chinese team beat their opponents in the final and won the championship.

quiz.zh: 敌人企图夺取这座城市，但遭到了顽强抵抗。
quiz.en: The enemy tried to seize the city but met fierce resistance.

example.zh: 这么美的风景，我以前从不曾见过。
example.en: I've never seen such beautiful scenery before.

quiz.zh: 他离开家乡二十年，却不曾忘记那里的一草一木。
quiz.en: He left his hometown twenty years ago, yet has never forgotten a single blade of grass or tree there.

example.zh: 婚礼上，我们请了专业人员摄像和拍照。
example.en: For the wedding, we hired professionals to film and take photos.

quiz.zh: 这次活动由小王负责摄像，小李负责拍照。
quiz.en: At this event Xiao Wang is in charge of filming and Xiao Li of taking photos.

运送.gloss: to transport, to ship, to carry

example.zh: 这批救灾物资将由直升机运送到灾区。
example.en: This batch of relief supplies will be flown to the disaster area by helicopter.

quiz.zh: 这条铁路每天可以运送上万名旅客。
quiz.en: This railway can carry tens of thousands of passengers a day.

特地.gloss: specially, on purpose, for a particular purpose

example.zh: 知道你喜欢吃饺子，妈妈特地给你包了一大盘。
example.en: Knowing you love dumplings, Mum made a big plate just for you.

quiz.zh: 他特地请了一天假，陪父母去医院做检查。
quiz.en: He took a day off specially to go with his parents for a check-up at the hospital.

example.zh: 他每天坚持锻炼，身体越来越强壮。
example.en: He exercises every day and is getting stronger and stronger.

quiz.zh: 这匹马又高又强壮，一天能跑上百公里。
quiz.en: This horse is tall and strong and can run over a hundred kilometres in a day.

example.zh: 他说的和事实有很大出入，我们不能全信。
example.en: What he said differs greatly from the facts, so we can't believe all of it.

quiz.zh: 两份报告里的数据有些出入，需要重新核对一下。
quiz.en: The figures in the two reports don't quite match and need to be checked again.

结尾.gloss: ending; to end, to wind up

example.zh: 这部电影的结尾让很多观众感到意外。
example.en: The ending of this film surprised many viewers.

quiz.zh: 作文的结尾要和开头相呼应。
quiz.en: The ending of an essay should echo its beginning.

钓鱼.gloss: to fish (with a rod), to go fishing

example.zh: 周末爸爸常常带我去湖边钓鱼。
example.en: At weekends Dad often takes me fishing by the lake.

quiz.zh: 这个湖禁止钓鱼，违者罚款两百元。
quiz.en: Fishing is forbidden in this lake; offenders will be fined 200 yuan.

捕.gloss: to catch, to seize, to capture

example.zh: 渔民们一大早就出海捕鱼了。
example.en: The fishermen set out to sea early in the morning to catch fish.

quiz.zh: 这次出海，渔民们捕到了一条两米多长的大鱼。
quiz.en: On this trip out to sea, the fishermen caught a fish over two metres long.

example.zh: 第一次见面，他就对这个女孩产生了好感。
example.en: He took a liking to this girl the first time they met.

quiz.zh: 这家店的服务员热情周到，让顾客很有好感。
quiz.en: The staff in this shop are warm and attentive, which leaves customers with a good impression.

example.zh: 为了写这篇论文，他搜集了大量资料。
example.en: He gathered a great deal of material to write this paper.

quiz.zh: 出发前，我在网上搜集了很多关于这座城市的旅游信息。
quiz.en: Before setting off, I gathered lots of travel information about the city online.

入选.gloss: to be selected, to be chosen

example.zh: 她的作品入选了全国青年美术展。
example.en: Her work was selected for the national young artists' exhibition.

quiz.zh: 凭着出色的表现，他入选了国家足球队。
quiz.en: Thanks to his outstanding performance, he was picked for the national football team.

发光.gloss: to shine, to glow, to give off light

example.zh: 萤火虫在夜里会发光，像一盏盏小灯。
example.en: Fireflies glow at night like little lamps.

quiz.zh: 这块手表的指针会在黑暗中发光，晚上也能看清时间。
quiz.en: The hands of this watch glow in the dark, so you can read the time at night.

example.zh: 在校长的陪同下，客人参观了新建的图书馆。
example.en: Accompanied by the principal, the guests toured the new library.

quiz.zh: 未成年人必须由家长陪同才能进入。
quiz.en: Minors may enter only when accompanied by a parent.

一身.gloss: the whole body, all over; a full outfit (of clothes)

example.zh: 跑完五公里，他出了一身汗，衣服全湿透了。
example.en: After running five kilometres he was sweating all over, his clothes soaked through.

quiz.zh: 他今天穿了一身西装，看起来特别精神。
quiz.en: He's wearing a full suit today and looks really sharp.

example.zh: 他个子中等，戴着一副眼镜，看起来很斯文。
example.en: He's of medium height, wears glasses and looks quite refined.

quiz.zh: 他的成绩在班里属于中等水平，不算好也不算差。
quiz.en: His grades are about average for the class, neither good nor bad.

example.zh: 下班后我们一道去吃饭吧，我知道附近有家不错的面馆。
example.en: Let's go and eat together after work; I know a good noodle place nearby.

quiz.zh: 他和几个老同学一道回母校看望了老师。
quiz.en: He went back to his old school together with a few former classmates to visit their teachers.

example.zh: 这些瓷器做工精美，是博物馆的珍藏。
example.en: These porcelain pieces are exquisitely made and are treasures of the museum.

quiz.zh: 礼物的包装十分精美，我都舍不得拆开。
quiz.en: The gift wrapping was so beautiful that I couldn't bear to open it.

example.zh: 他事后才知道，那天帮他的人就是新来的经理。
example.en: Only afterwards did he learn that the person who helped him that day was the new manager.

quiz.zh: 有问题要当面说清楚，不要事后再抱怨。
quiz.en: If you have a problem, say it clearly to people's faces; don't complain after the fact.

看重.gloss: to value, to regard as important, to think highly of

example.zh: 比起工资，我更看重工作的发展前景。
example.en: Rather than salary, I care more about a job's prospects.

quiz.zh: 这家公司招人时很看重应聘者的团队合作能力。
quiz.en: When hiring, this company places great importance on applicants' teamwork skills.

往来.gloss: to come and go; contact, dealings

example.zh: 大桥修好后，两岸居民往来方便多了。
example.en: Since the bridge was built, it's much easier for people on both banks to go back and forth.

quiz.zh: 我们两家公司已经有十几年的业务往来了。
quiz.en: Our two companies have had business dealings for more than ten years.

制品.gloss: products, goods (made of a given material)

example.zh: 这家工厂主要生产各种塑料制品。
example.en: This factory mainly produces all kinds of plastic goods.

quiz.zh: 牛奶、酸奶和奶酪都属于乳制品。
quiz.en: Milk, yogurt and cheese are all dairy products.

来往.gloss: to come and go; to have contact with, to associate with

example.zh: 路上来往的车辆很多，过马路要小心。
example.en: There's a lot of traffic coming and going, so be careful crossing the road.

quiz.zh: 妈妈不许我跟那些不三不四的人来往。
quiz.en: Mum won't let me hang around with those shady characters.

example.zh: 商店不得向未成年人出售烟酒。
example.en: Shops must not sell cigarettes or alcohol to minors.

quiz.zh: 网络游戏公司应该限制未成年人每天的游戏时间。
quiz.en: Online game companies should limit how long minors can play each day.

关爱.gloss: to care for, to show loving concern for

example.zh: 社会应该多关爱留守儿童，让他们健康成长。
example.en: Society should show more care for left-behind children so that they can grow up healthy.

quiz.zh: 在老师和同学们的关爱下，他很快走出了失去亲人的痛苦。
quiz.en: With the care of his teachers and classmates, he soon got over the pain of losing a loved one.

example.zh: 这种材料具有耐高温的特性。
example.en: This material has the property of withstanding high temperatures.

quiz.zh: 每种金属都有自己的特性，比如铜的导电性特别好。
quiz.en: Every metal has its own properties; copper, for example, conducts electricity especially well.

example.zh: 夏天的内蒙古大草原上，到处是成群的牛羊。
example.en: In summer the great Inner Mongolian grasslands are full of herds of cattle and sheep.

quiz.zh: 夏天的草原上开满了野花，一眼望不到边。
quiz.en: In summer the grassland is covered in wildflowers stretching as far as the eye can see.

example.zh: 今年这个地区遭了旱灾，粮食大量减产。
example.en: This region was hit by drought this year, and grain output fell sharply.

quiz.zh: 洪水过后，政府很快为受灾群众送去了食物和药品。
quiz.en: After the flood, the government quickly sent food and medicine to the people affected.

example.zh: 很多老年人喜欢买保健品，可有些并没有什么效果。
example.en: Many elderly people like buying health supplements, but some don't do much.

quiz.zh: 人上了年纪，就要更加重视日常的保健。
quiz.en: As people get older, they need to pay more attention to everyday health care.

转动.gloss: to turn, to rotate, to spin

example.zh: 他轻轻转动钥匙，门“咔”的一声开了。
example.en: He gently turned the key, and the door clicked open.

quiz.zh: 地球绕着自己的轴不停地转动，形成了白天和黑夜。
quiz.en: The Earth keeps rotating on its own axis, creating day and night.

example.zh: 这种饼干又香又脆，孩子们都爱吃。
example.en: These biscuits are fragrant and crunchy; the kids all love them.

quiz.zh: 这种玻璃很脆，不小心碰一下就碎了。
quiz.en: This glass is very brittle; one careless knock and it shatters.

example.zh: 如果服药后出现身体不适，请立即停药。
example.en: If you feel unwell after taking the medicine, stop taking it immediately.

quiz.zh: 刚到高原的游客常常会感到头晕等不适。
quiz.en: Tourists who have just arrived on the plateau often feel dizziness and other discomfort.

野生.gloss: wild, growing or living in the wild

example.zh: 这片森林里生活着很多野生动物。
example.en: Lots of wild animals live in this forest.

quiz.zh: 这种蘑菇是野生的，没有经过人工种植。
quiz.en: These mushrooms grow wild; they aren't cultivated.

example.zh: 抛硬币时，正面朝上的概率是百分之五十。
example.en: When you toss a coin, the probability of heads is fifty percent.

quiz.zh: 经常锻炼的人，得心脏病的概率要低得多。
quiz.en: People who exercise regularly are much less likely to get heart disease.

落地.gloss: to land (of a plane); to fall to the ground; to be put into practice

example.zh: 飞机将在二十分钟后落地，请大家系好安全带。
example.en: The plane will land in twenty minutes; please fasten your seat belts.

quiz.zh: 杯子从桌上掉下来，落地时摔得粉碎。
quiz.en: The cup fell off the table and smashed to pieces when it hit the floor.

example.zh: 她从五岁开始练体操，现在已经是国家队队员了。
example.en: She started doing gymnastics at five and is now on the national team.

quiz.zh: 每天上午第二节课后，全校学生都要在操场上做广播体操。
quiz.en: After the second class every morning, the whole school does group exercises to the radio on the sports field.

example.zh: 经常吃快餐又不运动，很容易导致肥胖。
example.en: Eating fast food often without exercising can easily lead to obesity.

quiz.zh: 儿童肥胖问题越来越严重，专家建议孩子们多运动。
quiz.en: Childhood obesity is getting more serious, and experts advise children to exercise more.

称作.gloss: to be called, to be known as

example.zh: 大熊猫性格温和、样子可爱，被称作中国的“国宝”。
example.en: Gentle and cute, the giant panda is called China's 'national treasure'.

quiz.zh: 杭州因为风景优美，被称作“人间天堂”。
quiz.en: Because of its beautiful scenery, Hangzhou is known as 'paradise on earth'.

example.zh: 办理签证的流程比以前简单多了。
example.en: The visa application process is much simpler than before.

quiz.zh: 新员工入职第一周，要先熟悉公司的工作流程。
quiz.en: In their first week, new employees have to get familiar with the company's work procedures.

example.zh: 如果您对上述内容有任何疑问，请随时联系我们。
example.en: If you have any questions about the above, please feel free to contact us.

quiz.zh: 符合上述条件的同学，可以在本周五之前报名。
quiz.en: Students who meet the above conditions may sign up before this Friday.

example.zh: 两辆汽车在十字路口发生碰撞，幸好没有人受伤。
example.en: Two cars collided at the crossroads; luckily no one was hurt.

quiz.zh: 两种不同观点的碰撞，往往能产生新的想法。
quiz.en: A clash between two different viewpoints often produces new ideas.

example.zh: 这档节目是提前录制好的，不是现场直播。
example.en: This show was pre-recorded, not broadcast live.

quiz.zh: 歌手花了半年时间，终于录制完了新专辑。
quiz.en: The singer spent half a year and finally finished recording the new album.

example.zh: 鲨鱼是海洋里最可怕的动物之一。
example.en: Sharks are among the most frightening animals in the ocean.

quiz.zh: 有人在海边游泳时看到了鲨鱼，海滩被暂时关闭了。
quiz.en: Someone swimming off the coast spotted a shark, and the beach was temporarily closed.

example.zh: 记者对这位作家进行了一次长时间的访谈。
example.en: The journalist conducted a long interview with the writer.

quiz.zh: 这个电视访谈节目每周邀请一位名人做嘉宾。
quiz.en: This TV talk show invites a celebrity guest every week.

example.zh: 这家工厂把污水直接排进河里，被罚了一大笔钱。
example.en: This factory discharged sewage straight into the river and was heavily fined.

quiz.zh: 城市污水经过处理后，可以用来浇花和冲厕所。
quiz.en: After treatment, urban wastewater can be used to water plants and flush toilets.

example.zh: 公司计划明年把业务扩展到东南亚市场。
example.en: The company plans to expand its business into Southeast Asian markets next year.

quiz.zh: 安装了这个插件以后，软件就能扩展出很多新功能。
quiz.en: Once you install this plug-in, the software can be extended with lots of new features.

加重.gloss: to make heavier; to aggravate, to worsen

example.zh: 感冒了还不按时吃药，只会加重病情。
example.en: If you have a cold and don't take your medicine on time, you'll only make it worse.

quiz.zh: 这次涨房租，又加重了年轻人的生活负担。
quiz.en: This rent increase has added to young people's financial burden yet again.

眼看.gloss: soon, in a moment; to watch (something happen) helplessly

example.zh: 眼看就要考试了，他却一点儿也不着急。
example.en: The exam is just around the corner, yet he's not worried at all.

quiz.zh: 他眼看着火车开走了，却一点办法也没有。
quiz.en: He watched the train pull away, but there was nothing he could do.

example.zh: 这种面包没有添加任何防腐剂。
example.en: This bread has no added preservatives.

quiz.zh: 请在微信上添加我为好友，有事随时联系。
quiz.en: Please add me as a friend on WeChat and contact me any time.

发病.gloss: to fall ill; (of an illness) to strike, to flare up

example.zh: 这种病多在冬季发病，老人和孩子要特别注意。
example.en: This illness usually strikes in winter; the elderly and children should be especially careful.

quiz.zh: 他有哮喘，一发病就喘不过气来。
quiz.en: He has asthma; whenever it flares up he can't catch his breath.

example.zh: 他匆匆吃了几口饭，就赶去上班了。
example.en: He gulped down a few mouthfuls and rushed off to work.

quiz.zh: 他每次回老家都来去匆匆，住不了两天就走。
quiz.en: Every time he goes back home it's a flying visit; he leaves after barely two days.

example.zh: 越来越多的年轻人有机会接受高等教育。
example.en: More and more young people have the chance to receive higher education.

quiz.zh: 这门高等数学课太难了，很多学生都没及格。
quiz.en: This advanced mathematics course is so hard that many students failed it.

当下.gloss: the present moment, now; right away, at once

example.zh: 与其担心未来，不如过好当下的每一天。
example.en: Rather than worry about the future, it's better to live each day well right now.

quiz.zh: 他一听说母亲病了，当下就买了回家的车票。
quiz.en: As soon as he heard his mother was ill, he bought a ticket home on the spot.

example.zh: 这列高铁的最高时速可以达到三百五十公里。
example.en: This high-speed train can reach a top speed of 350 kilometres per hour.

quiz.zh: 这段路限速六十，他却开到了时速一百二十公里，被交警拦了下来。
quiz.en: The speed limit on this stretch is 60, but he was doing 120 kilometres an hour and got pulled over by traffic police.

相连.gloss: to be linked, to be connected

example.zh: 这两座城市由一座跨海大桥相连。
example.en: These two cities are linked by a sea-crossing bridge.

quiz.zh: 卧室和阳台相连，早上阳光可以直接照进来。
quiz.en: The bedroom connects to the balcony, so the morning sun shines straight in.

限于.gloss: to be limited to, to be confined to

example.zh: 本次优惠活动仅限于新会员，老会员不能参加。
example.en: This promotion is limited to new members; existing members can't take part.

quiz.zh: 限于时间关系，今天的讨论就到这里。
quiz.en: Due to time constraints, we'll end today's discussion here.

example.zh: 她经常参加公益活动，去敬老院看望老人。
example.en: She often does charity work, visiting elderly people at the nursing home.

quiz.zh: 这则公益广告提醒大家开车时不要看手机。
quiz.en: This public service ad reminds everyone not to look at their phone while driving.

赞赏.gloss: to admire, to appreciate, to praise

example.zh: 他认真负责的工作态度得到了领导的赞赏。
example.en: His conscientious attitude to work won his boss's praise.

quiz.zh: 观众们纷纷赞赏这位年轻演员的精彩表演。
quiz.en: Audience members one after another praised the young actor's brilliant performance.

example.zh: 专家在节目中解读了新出台的房地产政策。
example.en: On the programme, experts explained the newly issued property policy.

quiz.zh: 同一首诗，不同的人可能会有不同的解读。
quiz.en: Different people may interpret the same poem in different ways.

example.zh: 新教室宽敞明亮，同学们都很喜欢。
example.en: The new classroom is spacious and bright, and all the students love it.

quiz.zh: 她有一双明亮的大眼睛，笑起来特别好看。
quiz.en: She has big bright eyes and looks especially lovely when she smiles.

example.zh: 房间刚装修完，要多开窗通风。
example.en: The room has just been renovated, so open the windows often to air it out.

quiz.zh: 地下室不通风，一直有股潮湿的味道。
quiz.en: The basement has no ventilation and always smells damp.

example.zh: 孩子们在操场上快乐地奔跑。
example.en: The children ran happily around the playground.

quiz.zh: 他在雨中奔跑着，想赶上最后一班公交车。
quiz.en: He ran through the rain, trying to catch the last bus.

减弱.gloss: to weaken, to diminish, to die down

example.zh: 台风登陆后风力逐渐减弱，雨也慢慢停了。
example.en: After the typhoon made landfall, the wind gradually weakened and the rain slowly stopped.

quiz.zh: 到了傍晚，阳光渐渐减弱，天色暗了下来。
quiz.en: Towards evening, the sunlight slowly faded and the sky grew dark.

绘画.gloss: to paint, to draw; painting, drawing

example.zh: 她从小就对绘画很感兴趣，常常一画就是一下午。
example.en: She has loved painting since she was little and often paints for a whole afternoon.

quiz.zh: 这次展览展出了一百多幅儿童绘画作品。
quiz.en: This exhibition displays more than a hundred children's paintings.

example.zh: 这部电影已经拍完了，现在正在做后期制作。
example.en: The filming is finished, and the movie is now in post-production.

quiz.zh: 比赛进入后期，双方队员的体力都明显下降了。
quiz.en: As the match entered its later stage, players on both sides were visibly tiring.

example.zh: 棒球在美国和日本非常受欢迎。
example.en: Baseball is very popular in the United States and Japan.

quiz.zh: 他戴上手套，准备接住飞过来的棒球。
quiz.en: He put on his glove, ready to catch the incoming baseball.

理财.gloss: to manage money, to manage one's finances

example.zh: 年轻人应该早点学会理财，不要每个月都把钱花光。
example.en: Young people should learn to manage their money early and not spend everything every month.

quiz.zh: 银行推出了一款新的理财产品，收益比存款高一些。
quiz.en: The bank launched a new investment product with slightly higher returns than a savings account.

观赏.gloss: to view and enjoy, to admire (sights, flowers)

example.zh: 每年春天，很多游客来这里观赏樱花。
example.en: Every spring, many tourists come here to admire the cherry blossoms.

quiz.zh: 这种鱼颜色鲜艳，很有观赏价值。
quiz.en: This fish is brightly coloured and has great ornamental value.

开创.gloss: to start, to initiate, to pioneer

example.zh: 这位科学家开创了一个全新的研究领域。
example.en: This scientist pioneered an entirely new field of research.

quiz.zh: 他的发明开创了一个新时代。
quiz.en: His invention ushered in a new era.

源于.gloss: to originate from, to stem from

example.zh: 很多中国的节日都源于古代的传说。
example.en: Many Chinese festivals originate from ancient legends.

quiz.zh: 他的自信源于多年来的努力和积累。
quiz.en: His self-confidence comes from years of hard work and experience.

构造.gloss: structure, construction; to construct, to build

example.zh: 这台机器的构造很复杂，一般人修不了。
example.en: This machine's structure is very complex; an ordinary person can't fix it.

quiz.zh: 老师用模型给我们介绍了人体心脏的构造。
quiz.en: The teacher used a model to show us the structure of the human heart.

example.zh: 每周一早上，学校都会举行升国旗仪式。
example.en: Every Monday morning, the school holds a flag-raising ceremony.

quiz.zh: 运动员站在领奖台上，看着国旗慢慢升起，激动得流下了眼泪。
quiz.en: Standing on the podium watching the national flag slowly rise, the athlete shed tears of emotion.

example.zh: 秋天到了，河面上漂着一片片金黄的落叶。
example.en: Autumn has come, and golden fallen leaves are floating on the river.

quiz.zh: 他把折好的纸船放进河里，看着它慢慢漂走了。
quiz.en: He put the folded paper boat in the river and watched it drift slowly away.

example.zh: 这座水库为全市提供了一半的饮用水。
example.en: This reservoir provides half the city's drinking water.

quiz.zh: 连续下了一周大雨，水库的水位已经超过了警戒线。
quiz.en: After a week of nonstop heavy rain, the reservoir's water level has passed the warning line.

example.zh: 每年都有成千上万的游客来这里看日出。
example.en: Every year tens of thousands of tourists come here to watch the sunrise.

quiz.zh: 这场演唱会吸引了成千上万的歌迷。
quiz.en: The concert drew thousands upon thousands of fans.

example.zh: 创业的道路十分艰辛，他吃了很多苦。
example.en: The road to starting a business is very hard, and he endured a lot.

quiz.zh: 他历尽艰辛，终于找到了失散多年的妹妹。
quiz.en: After going through countless hardships, he finally found the sister he had lost touch with for years.

example.zh: 天气越来越冷了，出门一定要注意保暖。
example.en: It's getting colder and colder, so be sure to keep warm when you go out.

quiz.zh: 这件羽绒服又轻又保暖，非常适合冬天穿。
quiz.en: This down jacket is light and warm, perfect for winter.

example.zh: 新年到了，祝愿您和家人身体健康，万事如意！
example.en: The New Year is here; wishing you and your family good health and every success!

quiz.zh: 在毕业典礼上，校长祝愿每位同学都有美好的未来。
quiz.en: At the graduation ceremony, the principal wished every student a bright future.

大吃一惊.gloss: to be greatly surprised, to be astonished

example.zh: 看到考试成绩，他大吃一惊，没想到自己考了满分。
example.en: He was astonished when he saw his exam result; he never expected a perfect score.

quiz.zh: 十年没见，老同学的变化让我大吃一惊。
quiz.en: I hadn't seen my old classmate for ten years, and I was amazed at how much he'd changed.

example.zh: 我们凌晨四点出发，终于在日出前爬到了山顶。
example.en: We set off at four in the morning and finally reached the summit before sunrise.

quiz.zh: 站在山顶往下看，整个城市都在眼前。
quiz.en: Looking down from the mountaintop, the whole city lay before us.

过时.gloss: outdated, out of fashion, obsolete; to go out of date

example.zh: 这件衣服的款式早就过时了。
example.en: The style of this outfit went out of fashion long ago.

quiz.zh: 技术发展太快，几年前学的知识现在可能已经过时了。
quiz.en: Technology moves so fast that what you learned a few years ago may already be outdated.

example.zh: 从我家到公司，开车大约半个小时的路程。
example.en: From my home to the office it's about a half-hour drive.

quiz.zh: 还有十公里的路程，坚持一下就到了。
quiz.en: There are only ten kilometres to go; hang in there and we'll be there.

引入.gloss: to introduce, to bring in (from outside)

example.zh: 这家医院引入了国外最先进的医疗设备。
example.en: This hospital has brought in the most advanced medical equipment from abroad.

quiz.zh: 老师用一个有趣的故事引入了今天的课题。
quiz.en: The teacher introduced today's topic with an interesting story.

example.zh: 勤洗手可以有效预防很多传染病。
example.en: Washing your hands often can effectively prevent many infectious diseases.

quiz.zh: 这种传染病传播速度很快，必须马上隔离病人。
quiz.en: This infectious disease spreads very fast; patients must be isolated immediately.

不成.gloss: won't do, no good; (at the end of a rhetorical question) is it that...?
不成.indonesian: tidak bisa, tidak boleh; (partikel pertanyaan retoris)

example.zh: 天都黑了，你难道要一个人走回去不成？
example.en: It's already dark; don't tell me you're going to walk back alone?

quiz.zh: 这个办法不成，我们得再想想别的。
quiz.en: This method won't work; we'll have to think of something else.

example.zh: 这里独特的沙漠景观每年吸引大量游客。
example.en: The unique desert landscape here attracts large numbers of tourists every year.

quiz.zh: 公园里新建了一个水上景观，晚上还有灯光秀。
quiz.en: The park has a new water feature, and there's a light show in the evening too.

example.zh: 夏天太热了，他在家只穿一件背心。
example.en: Summer is so hot that he wears just a vest at home.

quiz.zh: 工人们都穿着橙色的反光背心，在马路上施工。
quiz.en: The workers, all in orange reflective vests, were doing roadworks.

example.zh: 我在门口白白等了他两个小时，他根本没来。
example.en: I waited for him at the door for two hours for nothing; he never came.

quiz.zh: 机会就在眼前，千万别白白浪费了。
quiz.en: The opportunity is right in front of you; don't waste it.

野外.gloss: the outdoors, the wild, open country

example.zh: 周末我们去野外露营，晚上还看到了满天的星星。
example.en: At the weekend we went camping in the wild and saw a sky full of stars at night.

quiz.zh: 这种植物在野外已经很难找到了。
quiz.en: This plant is now very hard to find in the wild.

example.zh: 一条弯曲的小路通向山上的寺庙。
example.en: A winding path leads up to the temple on the mountain.

quiz.zh: 做这个动作时膝盖要微微弯曲，不要站得太直。
quiz.en: When doing this movement, keep your knees slightly bent; don't stand too straight.

example.zh: 医院规定，手术前必须由病人的亲属签字。
example.en: Hospital rules require a patient's relative to sign before surgery.

quiz.zh: 这项手续只能由本人或者直系亲属代为办理。
quiz.en: This procedure can only be handled by the person themselves or an immediate family member.

example.zh: 这里风很大，很适合建风力发电站。
example.en: It's very windy here, ideal for building a wind power station.

quiz.zh: 这座大坝建成以后，每年可以发电几十亿度。
quiz.en: Once built, this dam will be able to generate billions of kilowatt-hours of electricity a year.

创办.gloss: to found, to set up (a school, company, publication)

example.zh: 这所学校是由一位华侨在1920年创办的。
example.en: This school was founded in 1920 by an overseas Chinese.

quiz.zh: 大学毕业后，他和两个朋友一起创办了一家网络公司。
quiz.en: After graduating, he and two friends set up an internet company.

example.zh: 很多家庭在屋顶上安装了太阳能热水器。
example.en: Many families have installed solar water heaters on their roofs.

quiz.zh: 这辆车不用汽油，完全靠太阳能驱动。
quiz.en: This car uses no petrol; it runs entirely on solar power.

example.zh: 他站在海边，望着远方的轮船。
example.en: He stood by the sea, gazing at the ship in the distance.

quiz.zh: 年轻时，他总梦想着去远方看看外面的世界。
quiz.en: When he was young, he always dreamed of going far away to see the world.

example.zh: 老师耐心地解答了每一个学生的问题。
example.en: The teacher patiently answered every student's questions.

quiz.zh: 关于产品的任何问题，客服人员都会为您解答。
quiz.en: Our customer service staff will answer any questions you have about the product.

example.zh: 奶奶腿脚不方便，出门只能坐轮椅。
example.en: Grandma has trouble walking and can only go out in a wheelchair.

quiz.zh: 这座图书馆专门为坐轮椅的读者修建了无障碍通道。
quiz.en: This library built an accessible entrance especially for readers in wheelchairs.

example.zh: 他被困在电梯里，赶紧打电话求救。
example.en: He was trapped in the lift and quickly phoned for help.

quiz.zh: 船在海上遇到风暴，船长立刻发出了求救信号。
quiz.en: The ship ran into a storm at sea, and the captain immediately sent out a distress signal.

example.zh: 这台音箱的输出功率很大，适合在户外使用。
example.en: This speaker has a high output power and is good for outdoor use.

quiz.zh: 学语言不能只输入不输出，要多开口说。
quiz.en: When learning a language, it can't be all input and no output; you need to speak a lot.

诸多.gloss: many, numerous, a great deal of

example.zh: 新政策实施过程中遇到了诸多问题。
example.en: The new policy has run into many problems during implementation.

quiz.zh: 虽然面临诸多困难，他依然坚持完成了这个项目。
quiz.en: Despite facing numerous difficulties, he still saw the project through.

example.zh: 这些家具都是用上等木材做的。
example.en: All this furniture is made of top-quality timber.

quiz.zh: 为了保护森林，政府严格限制木材的砍伐和出口。
quiz.en: To protect the forests, the government strictly limits the logging and export of timber.

example.zh: 景德镇自古以生产瓷器闻名，被人们叫作“瓷都”。
example.en: Since ancient times Jingdezhen has been famous for its porcelain, and people call it the 'Porcelain Capital'.

quiz.zh: 这家老字号饭店的烤鸭闻名全国。
quiz.en: This long-established restaurant's roast duck is famous throughout the country.

古人.gloss: the ancients, people of ancient times

example.zh: 古人没有手表，是怎么知道时间的呢？
example.en: People in ancient times didn't have watches, so how did they tell the time?

quiz.zh: 古人说“读万卷书，行万里路”，意思是学习和实践都很重要。
quiz.en: The ancients said 'read ten thousand books, travel ten thousand miles', meaning both study and experience matter.

example.zh: 由于台风来临，港口里的船只都停止了出海。
example.en: With the typhoon coming, all the vessels in the harbour have stopped going out to sea.

quiz.zh: 这条运河每天都有大量船只往来。
quiz.en: Large numbers of boats travel up and down this canal every day.

example.zh: 项目的前期准备工作已经基本完成。
example.en: The preliminary preparations for the project are basically complete.

quiz.zh: 这个项目前期投入很大，要两三年以后才能赚钱。
quiz.en: This project needs heavy investment in its early stage and will take two or three years to turn a profit.

example.zh: 医生说，饭后不宜马上运动，最好先休息半小时。
example.en: The doctor says it isn't advisable to exercise right after a meal; it's best to rest for half an hour first.

quiz.zh: 这部电影有不少暴力镜头，不宜儿童观看。
quiz.en: This film has quite a few violent scenes and is unsuitable for children.

出境.gloss: to leave the country, to exit (a border)

example.zh: 出境旅游一定要带好护照和签证。
example.en: When travelling abroad, be sure to bring your passport and visa.

quiz.zh: 他因为欠钱不还，被法院限制出境了。
quiz.en: Because he refused to repay his debts, the court banned him from leaving the country.

example.zh: 北方冬天家家都有暖气，屋里一点儿也不冷。
example.en: In the north every home has heating in winter, so it's not cold indoors at all.

quiz.zh: 暖气坏了，我们只好穿着羽绒服在屋里看电视。
quiz.en: The heating broke, so we had to watch TV indoors in our down jackets.

评选.gloss: to select (by appraisal or vote), to choose

example.zh: 她被评选为今年的优秀教师。
example.en: She was chosen as this year's outstanding teacher.

quiz.zh: 这次评选活动由观众投票决定最受欢迎的歌手。
quiz.en: In this selection event, the audience votes to decide the most popular singer.

example.zh: 这家酒店的早餐是自助的，种类很多。
example.en: This hotel's breakfast is a self-service buffet with lots of choice.

quiz.zh: 现在很多银行都有自助取款机，取钱很方便。
quiz.en: Many banks now have self-service cash machines, so withdrawing money is easy.

开设.gloss: to open, to set up (a course, branch, account)

example.zh: 学校今年新开设了一门人工智能课程。
example.en: The school has launched a new artificial intelligence course this year.

quiz.zh: 这家银行在海外开设了二十多家分行。
quiz.en: This bank has opened more than twenty branches overseas.

example.zh: 今年的失业率比去年下降了两个百分点。
example.en: This year's unemployment rate is two percentage points lower than last year's.

quiz.zh: 这次考试的及格率比上次提高了五个百分点。
quiz.en: The pass rate in this exam rose by five percentage points compared with last time.

用餐.gloss: to have a meal, to dine

example.zh: 本店用餐时间为中午十一点到下午两点。
example.en: Our dining hours are from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m.

quiz.zh: 飞机上，空乘人员提醒乘客用餐时把座椅调直。
quiz.en: On the plane, the flight attendants reminded passengers to put their seats upright during the meal.

example.zh: 他花了很大工夫，才把这篇文章翻译好。
example.en: It took him a great deal of effort to translate this article.

quiz.zh: 一转眼的工夫，孩子就跑得不见了。
quiz.en: In the blink of an eye, the child had run off and disappeared.

看似.gloss: to seem, to look as if, apparently

example.zh: 这道题看似简单，其实很多人都做错了。
example.en: This question looks simple, but in fact lots of people got it wrong.

quiz.zh: 他看似不在乎，其实心里比谁都着急。
quiz.en: He seems not to care, but inside he's more anxious than anyone.

生成.gloss: to generate, to produce, to form

example.zh: 输入几个关键词，这个软件就能自动生成一篇文章。
example.en: Type in a few keywords and this software can automatically generate an article.

quiz.zh: 付款成功后，系统会自动生成订单号。
quiz.en: Once payment succeeds, the system automatically generates an order number.

example.zh: 他们俩上个月订婚了，打算明年春天结婚。
example.en: The two of them got engaged last month and plan to marry next spring.

quiz.zh: 订婚以后，两家人常常一起吃饭，关系越来越好。
quiz.en: After the engagement, the two families often ate together and grew closer and closer.

example.zh: 传说这座山里埋着很多金子，吸引了不少人来寻找。
example.en: Legend has it that lots of gold is buried in this mountain, which has drawn many people to search for it.

quiz.zh: 是金子总会发光的，只要坚持努力，总有一天会被人看见。
quiz.en: Gold will always shine; keep working hard and one day people will notice you.

example.zh: 中国地域辽阔，各地的风俗习惯差别很大。
example.en: China covers a vast territory, and customs vary greatly from place to place.

quiz.zh: 招聘时不应该有地域歧视，不能因为老家在哪儿就拒绝别人。
quiz.en: Hiring shouldn't involve regional discrimination; you can't reject someone because of where they come from.

热点.gloss: hot spot; hot topic, focus of attention

example.zh: 房价一直是社会关注的热点问题。
example.en: Housing prices have always been a hot topic of public concern.

quiz.zh: 这个小岛成了今年夏天的旅游热点。
quiz.en: This small island became this summer's hot tourist destination.

example.zh: 下雪后，环卫工人一大早就把人行道上的雪扫干净了。
example.en: After the snowfall, sanitation workers swept the snow off the pavement first thing in the morning.

quiz.zh: 有人把电动车停在人行道上，挡住了行人。
quiz.en: Someone parked an e-bike on the sidewalk, blocking pedestrians.

摆放.gloss: to place, to put, to arrange (objects)

example.zh: 书架上的书摆放得整整齐齐。
example.en: The books on the shelf are neatly arranged.

quiz.zh: 客厅里摆放着几盆绿色植物，看起来很有生气。
quiz.en: There are several potted plants in the living room, which makes it look lively.

看中.gloss: to take a fancy to, to settle on (choose)

example.zh: 她在商场里一眼就看中了那双白色运动鞋。
example.en: She took a fancy to that pair of white trainers the moment she saw them in the mall.

quiz.zh: 我们看了十几套房子，终于看中了一套离公司近的。
quiz.en: We looked at more than a dozen flats and finally settled on one close to the office.

example.zh: 这里的自来水不能直接喝，要烧开了才行。
example.en: The tap water here isn't safe to drink straight; it has to be boiled first.

quiz.zh: 以前村里人都去井里打水，现在家家都通了自来水。
quiz.en: Villagers used to draw water from the well; now every home has running water.

example.zh: 这一带地形复杂，开车一定要小心。
example.en: The terrain around here is complicated, so drive carefully.

quiz.zh: 云南地形以山地为主，平原很少。
quiz.en: Yunnan's terrain is mainly mountainous, with very few plains.

example.zh: 这位画家年轻时没什么名气，晚年作品才受到重视。
example.en: This painter wasn't well known when young; only in later life did his work get attention.

quiz.zh: 这部电影让这位年轻导演的名气越来越大。
quiz.en: This film has made the young director more and more famous.

养老.gloss: to provide for the elderly; to live out one's old age, retirement
养老.indonesian: merawat orang tua; menjalani masa tua

example.zh: 很多人退休后选择回老家养老。
example.en: Many people choose to spend their retirement back in their hometown.

quiz.zh: 年轻时多存点钱，将来养老才不用发愁。
quiz.en: Save more while you're young, so you won't have to worry about old age.

example.zh: 这家百货商场今天开始打折，人特别多。
example.en: This department store started its sale today and it's packed.

quiz.zh: 小镇上只有一家百货店，日用品基本都能买到。
quiz.en: There's only one general store in the small town, but you can get most everyday items there.

example.zh: 下雪后路面很滑，开车要慢一点。
example.en: After snow the road surface is slippery, so drive more slowly.

quiz.zh: 这条马路年久失修，路面坑坑洼洼的。
quiz.en: This road hasn't been repaired for years, and its surface is full of potholes.

example.zh: 孩子到了青春期，常常不愿意和父母说心里话。
example.en: When children reach adolescence, they're often unwilling to open up to their parents.

quiz.zh: 他青春期的时候长得特别快，一年长高了十厘米。
quiz.en: He grew very fast during puberty, gaining ten centimetres in a year.

example.zh: 做面包需要面粉、鸡蛋、牛奶和黄油。
example.en: To make bread you need flour, eggs, milk and butter.

quiz.zh: 妈妈去超市买了一袋面粉，准备周末包饺子。
quiz.en: Mum bought a bag of flour at the supermarket to make dumplings at the weekend.

example.zh: 用手机支付既方便又快捷，现在很少有人带现金了。
example.en: Paying by phone is convenient and quick; few people carry cash any more.

quiz.zh: 这家快递公司服务快捷，昨天寄的东西今天就到了。
quiz.en: This courier company is fast; something sent yesterday arrived today.

example.zh: 楼前有一块空地，孩子们常在那里踢球。
example.en: There's an open space in front of the building where the kids often play football.

quiz.zh: 市政府计划在这块空地上建一座公园。
quiz.en: The city government plans to build a park on this vacant lot.

example.zh: 在火车站请保管好您的随身财物。
example.en: Please keep an eye on your belongings at the railway station.

quiz.zh: 小偷趁家里没人，偷走了不少财物。
quiz.en: Taking advantage of nobody being home, the thief stole quite a lot of valuables.

example.zh: 我的耐心是有限度的，你别太过分了。
example.en: My patience has its limits, so don't push it.

quiz.zh: 我们要最大限度地减少浪费。
quiz.en: We must reduce waste as much as possible.

example.zh: 我妈妈有两个姐姐，我叫她们大姨和二姨。
example.en: My mother has two older sisters; I call them Big Auntie and Second Auntie.

quiz.zh: 暑假我去小姨家住了一个月，她天天带我出去玩。
quiz.en: In the summer holidays I stayed at my youngest aunt's for a month, and she took me out every day.

example.zh: 每天中午，写字楼附近的餐厅里坐满了白领。
example.en: Every day at noon, the restaurants near the office buildings are full of white-collar workers.

quiz.zh: 很多年轻白领下班后还要去健身房锻炼。
quiz.en: Many young office workers go to the gym after work.

example.zh: 冬天湖面结了冰，很多人来这里滑冰。
example.en: In winter the lake freezes over and lots of people come here to skate.

quiz.zh: 她穿上冰鞋，第一次滑冰就摔了好几跤。
quiz.en: She put on her skates and fell several times the first time she went skating.

example.zh: 这个地区人口密集，交通压力很大。
example.en: This area is densely populated, and traffic is under heavy strain.

quiz.zh: 市中心高楼密集，到了晚上灯火通明。
quiz.en: The city centre is packed with high-rises, and at night it's brightly lit.

仰.gloss: to face upward, to look up, to tilt one's head back

example.zh: 他站在院子里，仰着头看天上的星星。
example.en: He stood in the yard, head tilted back, looking at the stars in the sky.

quiz.zh: 他仰起头，一口气把一瓶水喝光了。
quiz.en: He tipped his head back and drank the whole bottle of water in one go.

example.zh: 苹果和香蕉相比，我更喜欢前者。
example.en: Between apples and bananas, I prefer the former.

quiz.zh: 城市生活方便，乡村生活安静，我父母更喜欢前者，所以一直住在城里。
quiz.en: City life is convenient and country life is quiet; my parents prefer the former, so they've always lived in town.

example.zh: 外国游客入境时需要出示护照和签证。
example.en: Foreign visitors must show their passport and visa when entering the country.

quiz.zh: 飞机降落以后，乘客要先排队办理入境手续。
quiz.en: After the plane lands, passengers first queue to go through entry formalities.

example.zh: 这条街的照明设施太差，晚上走路很不安全。
example.en: The lighting on this street is so poor that it's unsafe to walk at night.

quiz.zh: 停电后，大家只能用手机来照明。
quiz.en: After the power went out, everyone had to use their phones for light.

example.zh: 每个月一号，信用卡账单就会发到我的手机上。
example.en: On the first of every month, my credit card statement is sent to my phone.

quiz.zh: 这个月的电费账单比上个月高了一倍。
quiz.en: This month's electricity bill is twice as high as last month's.

短缺.gloss: shortage; to be in short supply

example.zh: 由于连续干旱，这个地区出现了严重的水资源短缺。
example.en: Because of continuous drought, this region has a severe water shortage.

quiz.zh: 很多农村医院面临医生短缺的问题。
quiz.en: Many rural hospitals face a shortage of doctors.

example.zh: 秋天公园里开满了各种颜色的菊花。
example.en: In autumn the park is full of chrysanthemums of every colour.

quiz.zh: 夏天喝点菊花茶，可以清热降火。
quiz.en: Drinking some chrysanthemum tea in summer helps cool the body.

example.zh: 请用黑色钢笔在表格上书写姓名。
example.en: Please write your name on the form with a black pen.

quiz.zh: 他书写工整，老师常常把他的作业贴在墙上给大家看。
quiz.en: His handwriting is so neat that the teacher often pins his homework on the wall for everyone to see.

example.zh: 来这里旅游的大都是年轻人。
example.en: Most of the people who travel here are young.

quiz.zh: 他的朋友大都是大学同学，毕业后还经常见面。
quiz.en: His friends are mostly university classmates, and they still meet often since graduating.

example.zh: 老师夸奖他作业写得认真，让大家向他学习。
example.en: The teacher praised him for doing his homework carefully and told everyone to learn from him.

quiz.zh: 孩子做了好事，父母应该及时夸奖。
quiz.en: When children do something good, parents should praise them right away.

example.zh: 人行道上的盲道是专门为盲人设计的。
example.en: The tactile paving on the sidewalk is designed especially for blind people.

quiz.zh: 这位盲人钢琴家虽然看不见，却能弹出动人的音乐。
quiz.en: Though he can't see, this blind pianist plays moving music.

讲解.gloss: to explain, to give a guided commentary

example.zh: 导游一边走一边给我们讲解这座古城的历史。
example.en: As we walked, the guide explained the history of the ancient city to us.

quiz.zh: 这道题我不太明白，你能再给我讲解一遍吗？
quiz.en: I don't really understand this question; could you explain it to me once more?

example.zh: 这个冰箱的容量比较大，适合一家五口用。
example.en: This fridge has a fairly large capacity, suitable for a family of five.

quiz.zh: 手机内存容量不够了，照片都存不进去了。
quiz.en: My phone's storage is full; I can't save any more photos.

example.zh: 这套教材是由几位资深老师共同编写的。
example.en: This set of textbooks was written jointly by several experienced teachers.

quiz.zh: 他花了一个星期，编写了一个自动统计成绩的小程序。
quiz.en: He spent a week writing a small program that tallies grades automatically.

抽奖.gloss: to draw a prize, to enter a lucky draw; lucky draw

example.zh: 年会上公司举办了抽奖活动，一等奖是一台电脑。
example.en: The company held a lucky draw at the annual party; the first prize was a computer.

quiz.zh: 购物满两百元就可以参加抽奖，最高能抽到一部手机。
quiz.en: Spend 200 yuan and you can enter the prize draw; the top prize is a mobile phone.

认错.gloss: to admit a mistake, to apologize

example.zh: 孩子做错了事，主动向妈妈认错。
example.en: The child did something wrong and owned up to his mother of his own accord.

quiz.zh: 他这个人特别要面子，明知道自己错了也不肯认错。
quiz.en: He cares so much about saving face that he won't admit he's wrong even when he knows it.

example.zh: 事故发生后，伤员被迅速送往附近的医院。
example.en: After the accident, the injured were rushed to a nearby hospital.

quiz.zh: 医生和护士连夜抢救伤员，一直忙到天亮。
quiz.en: Doctors and nurses worked through the night to save the wounded, busy until dawn.

兴起.gloss: to rise, to spring up, to become popular

example.zh: 最近几年，城市里兴起了一股露营热。
example.en: In recent years, a camping craze has sprung up in the cities.

quiz.zh: 这座城市是在清朝时因为贸易而兴起的。
quiz.en: This city rose to prominence through trade during the Qing dynasty.

example.zh: 这些旧报纸还有用处，先别扔。
example.en: These old newspapers can still be used; don't throw them away yet.

quiz.zh: 你学这个到底有什么用处？我看一点用都没有。
quiz.en: What's the point of learning this? It seems completely useless to me.

example.zh: 这片海域风浪很大，渔船很少到这里来。
example.en: The waves in these waters are rough, and fishing boats seldom come here.

quiz.zh: 一艘货船在南海海域遇险，救援人员已经赶往现场。
quiz.en: A cargo ship ran into trouble in the waters of the South China Sea, and rescuers are rushing to the scene.

输送.gloss: to convey, to transport, to deliver (via pipes etc.); to supply

example.zh: 这条管道每天向城市输送大量天然气。
example.en: This pipeline delivers large amounts of natural gas to the city every day.

quiz.zh: 心脏不停地跳动，把血液输送到全身。
quiz.en: The heart beats nonstop, pumping blood throughout the body.

就读.gloss: to attend school, to study at (a school)

example.zh: 他目前在北京大学就读，学的是法律。
example.en: He is currently studying law at Peking University.

quiz.zh: 这所小学目前有一千多名学生就读。
quiz.en: More than a thousand pupils currently attend this primary school.
